question: Which entities are assigned to the southeastern and southwestern petals?
premises: Tāmasa is associated with the fire direction.
Rājasa is associated with the Nirṛti direction petal.
inference: Tāmasa is placed in the southeastern part and Rājasa on the southwestern petal.
plain_english: Place Tāmasa in the southeastern part and Rājasa on the southwestern petal.
